text: without end, there is emptiness. There is the emptiness of non-repudiation. There is the emptiness of intrinsic nature. There is the emptiness of all dharmas. There is the emptiness of own-characteristics. There is the emptiness of non-apprehension. There is the emptiness of the absence of entities. There is the emptiness of essential nature. There is the emptiness of the essential nature of the absence of entities. There are the applications of mindfulness. There are the right abandonments. There are the bases of miraculous power. There are the faculties. There are the powers. There are the limbs of awakening. There is the noble eightfold path. There are the noble truths. There are the meditative concentrations. There are the immeasurables. There are the formless absorptions. There are the eight liberations. There are the nine successive absorptions. There are the gates of liberation: emptiness, signlessness, and wishlessness. There are the superknowledges. There are the samādhis. There are the dhāraṇī-gates. The Tathāga-
